{{Top|leg}}
A '''funfair''' was an event that featured attractions of various kinds. One such event was held on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref> in [[18 BBY/Legends|18.46 BBY]]<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=07440#17398526|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-14|time=11:47 AM}}</ref> and featured [[virtual reality]] attractions such as the [[Corrobor]] and the [[Droidome]].<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows" />

==Behind the scenes==
Funfairs were mentioned in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]].<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows />
